root_cause.text: The smc_msg_event tracepoint unconditionally dereferences conn->lnk without checking if it is NULL, but conn->lnk is only initialized for SMC-R connections while remaining NULL for SMC-D connections.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `__string(name, smc->conn.lnk->ibname)` to `__string(name, smc->conn.lnk ? smc->conn.lnk->ibname : "")`, adding a NULL check. The CVE description confirms that "conn->lnk is only set for SMC-R; for SMC-D it is NULL" and that the crash occurs at the exact offset of the ibname field within the smc_link structure (0x3e0), proving the NULL pointer dereference. The vulnerability is triggered when any unprivileged user calls sendmsg()/recvmsg() on an SMC-D socket with the tracepoint enabled, demonstrating that the code path lacks the NULL-check guards that exist elsewhere in the codebase (e.g., SMC_STAT_RMB_TX_SIZE_SMALL()).

intent_record.intent_summary: Add null pointer check to prevent potential crash when smc->conn.lnk is NULL in the SMC message event tracepoint.
intent_record.what: Modified the __string() macro argument from direct pointer dereference `smc->conn.lnk->ibname` to a conditional expression `smc->conn.lnk ? smc->conn.lnk->ibname : ""` that checks if the pointer is non-null before dereferencing.
intent_record.how: This change prevents a null pointer dereference at runtime. If `smc->conn.lnk` is NULL, the original code would crash when attempting to access the `ibname` field. The new code safely returns an empty string instead, allowing the tracepoint to execute without fault.

commit aff3083f10bff7a37eaa2b4e6bc5fb627ddd5f84
Author: Tony Lu <tonylu@linux.alibaba.com>
Date:   Mon Nov 1 15:39:14 2021 +0800

    net/smc: Introduce tracepoints for tx and rx msg
    
    This introduce two tracepoints for smc tx and rx msg to help us
    diagnosis issues of data path. These two tracepoitns don't cover the
    path of CORK or MSG_MORE in tx, just the top half of data path.
    
    Signed-off-by: Tony Lu <tonylu@linux.alibaba.com>
    Reviewed-by: Wen Gu <guwen@linux.alibaba
bic_trace_step.reason: The code unconditionally dereferences `smc->conn.lnk->ibname` in the TP_STRUCT__entry and TP_fast_assign sections without any NULL check. Specifically, line `__string(name, smc->conn.lnk->ibname)` and line `__assign_str(name, smc->conn.lnk->ibname)` both access `smc->conn.lnk->ibname` directly. According to the vulnerability root cause, `conn->lnk` is only initialized for SMC-R connections and remains NULL for SMC-D connections, making this a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability. The tracepoint will be invoked for both SMC-R and SMC-D connections, but the code does not check if `lnk` is NULL before dereferencing it.
